blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Police arrested Eastern Visayas’ No. 1 drug suspect, two other high-value individuals, and five others in separate anti-drug operations on Oct. 12 and 13. The Police Regional Office 8 said the operations yielded suspected shabu worth P1,035,844, based on Dangerous Drugs Board valuations, along with firearms and ammunition, as part of the intensified anti-drug campaign led by its regional director, Brig. Gen. Romano Cardiño. On Oct. 12, operatives of the Regional Police Drug Enforcement Unit 8, in coordination with the Barugo Municipal Police Station, arrested alias “Sonnie,” a 57-year-old beautician from Barugo, Leyte.
